qa_pairs.question: In the Metrix portal, what specific memory usage information is available within the "GPU accounts" section?
qa_pairs.answer: Within the "GPU accounts" section of the Metrix portal, users can view the memory used by each individual in their group.

qa_pairs.question: How is the memory usage by individual users within a group presented in the "GPU accounts" section of the Metrix portal?
qa_pairs.answer: The memory used by each user in your group is presented visually within the "GPU accounts" section of the Metrix portal, typically as a graph, as indicated by the associated image file name.
